description:
An open-source private cloud you run yourself: identity, directory, RBAC, secrets, certificates, object storage, events, metrics, audit, messaging, jobs and tunnels, on an immutable awnix base on hardware you own. The parts a stranger can adopt alone are these bricks. The control plane behind them (Identity, Directory, Secrets, Strata, Flux, Pulse, Watch, Chronicle, Nexus, Relay) is a set of platform services that the sovereign-replica layer set stands up, not bricks. Solutions (CRM, mail, web hosting, MDM, the OccupySaaS packs) ship as optional packs on top and are never baked in.

Includes: awnix, awdaemons, awrun, awiam, awbac, awdit, awseal, awrelay, awtunnel, awpack
